pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe sattarasavaggiyā dārakā sahāyakā honti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.4: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.5: kena nu kho upāyena Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.6: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.7: sace kho Upāli lekhaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.8: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.9: sace kho Upāli lekhaṃ sikkhissati, aṅguliyo dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.10: sace kho Upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.11: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.12: sace kho Upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkhissati, urassa dukkho bhavissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.13: sace kho Upāli rūpaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.14: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.15: sace kho Upāli rūpaṃ sikkhissati, akkhīni dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.16: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.17: sace kho Upāli samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.18: assosi kho Upāli dārako mātāpitunnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.19: atha kho Upāli dārako yena te dārakā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te dārake etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.20: etha mayaṃ ayyo samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.21: sace kho tvaṃ ayya pabbajissasi, evaṃ mayam pi pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.22: atha kho te dārakā ekamekassa mātāpitaro upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.25: sabbe p' ime dārakā samānacchandā kalyāṇādhippāyā 'ti anujāniṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.29: yāguṃ detha, bhattaṃ detha, khādaniyaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.35: no ce bhavissati yāgu vā bhattaṃ vā khādaniyaṃ vā, piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjissathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.36: evam pi kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā rodanti yeva:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.37: yāguṃ detha, bhattaṃ detha, khādaniyaṃ dethā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.39: assosi kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dārakasaddaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.41: kiṃ nu kho so Ānanda dārakasaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.42: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.43: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.44: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.47: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.48: ūnavīsativasso bhikkhave puggalo akkhamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātiko hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.49: vīsativasso ca kho bhikkhave puggalo khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.51: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.52: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.53.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya, so ca puggalo anupasampanno te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.9: upasampādessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.13: gaṇassa ca ācariyassa ca āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||1||
